q: Which Jubail petrochemical and fertiliser exports to the EU need CBAM data?
title: Jubail exports covered by CBAM
short: Ammonia, urea and other nitrogen fertilisers, nitric acid, mixed fertilisers and hydrogen are CBAM goods. Methanol, polymers such as polyethylene and polypropylene, glycols and most other organic chemicals are not in Annex I, so they need no CBAM data today.
audience: Petrochemical and fertiliser producers in Jubail and other Gulf industrial cities selling to EU importers

ul: 3102: nitrogenous fertilisers, such as urea and ammonium sulphate.
3105: mixed fertilisers such as DAP and NPK, except 3105 60 00.
Methanol and other alcohols in chapter 29.
Polymers in primary forms in chapter 39.
Glycols, aromatics and other organic chemicals.

p: For fertiliser goods, CBAM counts direct emissions and indirect emissions from electricity. Ammonia is a precursor of urea and nitric acid, so its embedded emissions flow into theirs. For hydrogen only direct emissions count. Importers bringing in 50 tonnes or less a year of CBAM goods are exempt, but the exemption does not apply to hydrogen.
